stories.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers for "mishandling research information"
stories.reason: OpenAI fired 3 safety researchers over alleged research-info mishandling; researchers dispute it and warn of a chilling effect on internal safety work. High engagement (318 pts), credible outlet (TechCrunch), real governance story.
key_facts: TechCrunch reports OpenAI fired three safety researchers
OpenAI cites mishandling of research information as cause
The fired researchers dispute the misconduct characterization
They warn the firings will chill future internal safety reporting

stories.title: Step 5 Preview, a 1M-context MoE from StepFun, shows up on OpenRouter
stories.reason: StepFun's Step 5 Preview is a 1M-context MoE model now live on OpenRouter, giving outside users hands-on access rather than just an announcement. Fits open-weight/inference-infra interest.
key_facts: Step 5 Preview is a MoE model from StepFun

stories.title: bilibili/Index-Translate
stories.reason: Bilibili released Index-Translate, a real open-weight translation model family (2B/9B/35B-A3B checkpoints, GGUF/FP8/FP4 quants, free API), covering 150 languages plus voice-preserving and long-document variants. Matches 'open-weight releases with published weights.'
key_facts: Index-Translate family built on Qwen3.5, from bilibili
Checkpoints at 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B released on HF/ModelScope
Covers 150 languages; includes Index-Echo (voice-preserving speech translation), Index-Homura (syllable-controlled), Index-NativeLong (long-document)
GGUF/FP8/FP4 quantized builds and a free public API for the 35B-A3B model

stories.title: Typesafe AI raises $870M at $7.5B
stories.reason: Typesafe AI raised $870M at a $7.5B valuation — well above the funding floor and plausibly the company behind the 'Jev'/decision-model product line seen across several of today's repos (e.g. thesys-core's 'TypeSafe Jev' classifier), tying a saturated wave back to one real, large financing story.

stories.title: Iranian campaign planted fake articles in real U.S. publications using ChatGPT
stories.reason: Washington Post reports an Iranian influence operation planted ChatGPT-drafted articles in real US publications — a concrete, sourced case of generative AI used for state-linked disinformation placement, distinct from the already-exhausted 'agent causes incident' framing. Big enough that not knowing it is a gap.

stories.title: MXC - a sandboxed code execution system
stories.reason: MXC is Microsoft's real sandboxed code-execution system for running untrusted model output/tool calls, with pluggable OS-native backends and policy-driven filesystem/network/UI controls. Running infra code, not just a proposal.
key_facts: MXC = sandboxed code execution system from Microsoft, cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS)
SDKs in Rust, .NET, Node; backends include ProcessContainer, Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, Windows Sandbox, LXC, MicroVM
Includes an audit mode for building policies (disables sandbox security, not for untrusted code)

stories.title: OpenAI, the Partition Principle, and Mathematics
stories.reason: A mathematician's critique of OpenAI's handling of a math result (Partition Principle) — the freshest and most substantive angle in today's OpenAI-math-reliability cluster; picking this one over the other three to avoid running the same trend four times.

stories.title: Pointing AI at archives found a forgotten meteorite, lost rhinos, and more
stories.reason: AI applied to 400 years of archives surfacing a previously unknown meteorite and 'lost' rhinos — a concrete, novel AI-for-research application story rather than another vendor announcement.
